Ontology_AssayAndWorkflow_prompt.notes: The proteomics experiment is a standard AP-MS (Affinity Purification Mass Spectrometry) to identify interactors of MRG15 and ASH1L. While the biological study focuses heavily on H3K4me3 (histone methylation), the mass spectrometry part described in the PRIDE metadata and methods is an interactome screen using Flag-tagged proteins, not a PTM-enrichment assay for the methyl-marks themselves. Acquisition is inferred as DDA based on the use of Q Exactive and MaxQuant/Andromeda for an interactome screen. Labeling is LFQ as no isobaric tags or SILAC are mentioned.

scope: 40 µl anti-Flag M2 affinity gel (Sigma) were incubated with 500 µg of whole-cell lysate overnight at 4 C on a turning wheel.
Protein elution was carried out by the incubation of the beads with 3x Flag peptide (Sigma) as the competitor for 40 min at 4 C
Supernatants were analyzed by mass spectrometry
